title: Source-grounded audit of OTA-SCI-0044 against the primary Garcia-Bernete et al. Nature Astronomy (2026) paper on IRAS 07251-0248
question: Audit the [R]-marked claims in OTA-SCI-0044-2026-DE against the primary publication 'Abundant hydrocarbons in a buried galactic nucleus with signs of carbonaceous grain and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon processing' (Garcia-Bernete et al., Nature Astronomy 2026, DOI 10.1038/s41550-025-02750-0) and the current literature. Which specifics are accurate - first extragalactic CH3 (methyl radical) detection, benzene/acetylene/diacetylene inventory, 2-10x over-abundance vs. models, the cosmic-ray-ionization/C2H2 correlation (r ~ 0.85), ~160 km/s outflow, T_dust > 500 K / n_H conditions - and which are misattributed? The document credits the research article to 'Spilker et al.' (arXiv 2602.04967) and lists a separate News & Views item; the published research article's first author is Garcia-Bernete, so the attribution and the arXiv ID need correction. This document is the declared empirical foundation (85% [R]) of the RKF framework (OTA-FND-0012/0013/0014/0015).
why_now: The doc (dated 2026-02-16) cites only arXiv/press-release sources without a DOI, and the first-author attribution conflicts with the published paper. Because OTA-SCI-0044 is the load-bearing real-world anchor for the entire RKF classification chain, correcting the citation and any numeric misstatements has outsized impact on archive plausibility and on the astrochemistry/prebiotic-chemistry learning content reused by SSF.
real_world_anchor: Garcia-Bernete et al. (2026), Nature Astronomy, DOI 10.1038/s41550-025-02750-0 — JWST NIRSpec/MIRI observations of the ULIRG IRAS 07251-0248 (first extragalactic CH3, hydrocarbons 2-10x above models, ~160 km/s outflow)
novelty_reason: Distinct from the prior interstellar-sulfur audit (RES-20260829-DA7FADB5, OTA-SCI-0026, Araki et al.): this gap targets a different document (OTA-SCI-0044) and a different paper (Garcia-Bernete et al., Nature Astronomy 2026, extragalactic hydrocarbons in IRAS 07251-0248), specifically the Spilker-vs-Garcia-Bernete first-author attribution and the RKF-framework dependency. It is not a rephrasing of any prior topic.
